about: Written blind from news.json alone (no repository file, other evaluation set or doc was read; the assistant and its tests were not run): 60 short, loose spoken requests to Jarvis, made up from today's 27-story news panel (daily order) and the week's stored stories, each golded with what a sharp aide would do, then machine-checked (the JSON parses, ids are unique, every regex compiles with the i flag, each story pattern matches exactly its one intended title among the daily and weekly titles, each newsAbout pattern matches at least one title, storyN lies within 1-27, and each outlet reference names an outlet with a single story on today's panel). Ids are n9-<kind>-<k>; below they drop the n9- prefix. Kinds: newsTopic 22 (en 8, ta 7, tg 7), newsAsk 16 (en 6, ta 5, tg 5), reference 14 (en 6, ta 4, tg 4; all with screen newsPanel) and 8 controls (command 7, question 1; en 4, ta 2, tg 2); languages en 24, ta (Tamil script) 18, tg (Tanglish) 18; gold.lang is en for English and ta for Tamil script and Tanglish, and Tanglish items often carry heard en, Whisper's usual label for them. Deliberate Whisper slips are in 20 items: acronyms said letter by letter, D R I (newsTopic-1), B. I. S. (newsTopic-3), I O C L (newsTopic-4), T V K (newsTopic-18), chat G P T (newsTopic-22), G C C (newsAsk-4), R.B.I. (newsAsk-6); places and names split or spelt as heard, Kathi para (newsTopic-2), Vandaloor (newsTopic-6), Pattina pakkam (newsTopic-8), கொடுங்கயூர் (newsTopic-11), Palli karanai (newsTopic-16), Anna Nagar for the title's Annanagar (newsTopic-17), Kannadasan (newsTopic-20), Veera Mani (newsAsk-2), Aavadi (newsAsk-14), Tiruvotriyur (newsAsk-15); outlets misheard, N D T V (reference-5), Malai Malar (reference-6), D T Next (reference-13). Other hard cases, not counted as slips: spoken colloquial Tamil (postpositions -ல, -ட்டுல, -க்குள்ள, பத்தி/பத்தின, and spoken verbs telling the event instead of the headline's words, e.g. கடத்தப் பாத்தாங்க, கொடியசைச்சு அனுப்புனாரே, நொறுங்குச்சாமே) in newsTopic-9 to 15, newsAsk-7 to 11, reference-9, reference-10 and command-4, and everyday Tanglish (current thiruttu, kosu, current cut) in newsTopic-19, newsAsk-12 and newsAsk-16; ordinals past five (seventh, Number 11, twelfth, எட்டாவது, இருபதாவது, pathinettavadhu, irubathi naalavadhu, irubathi rendavadhu) and the last one / கடைசி; outlet references (NDTV, Maalaimalar, Makkal Kural, DT Next); three number traps where the number belongs to the story, not the panel (ஒன்பதாவது மாடி in newsTopic-13, 24 edathula in newsTopic-19, aaru flyover in newsTopic-21); 17 topic-only requests with no news word (newsTopic-1 to 5, 7, 8, 10 to 12, 15 and 17 to 22; six of them with the panel on screen: 1, 4, 5, 11, 19, 21); three weekly-only stories asked while today's panel shows (newsTopic-4, 11, 13); five requests with no wake word that rely on being engaged (engagedSec 3 to 8); and controls that share words with the news (open, show, காட்டு, திறங்க with a zone and a problem word), golded with zone, page or recipe. Patterns are English because every title in news.json is English; some add a Tamil alternation that matches no other story. storyN is the 1-based position on today's news panel (news.json daily order: 1 is 'Seizure of drugs worth Rs. 140 crore near Madhavaram', 27 is 'Unauthorised Buildings Major Enforcement Challenge in Chennai'); it is used only for numeric ordinals, while the last one and outlet references carry that story's title pattern. No item uses orNothing: every news question has at least one matching stored story.

items.text: Jarvis, open that D R I heroin seizure.
items.note: slip: acronym said letter by letter (D R I); no news word, panel showing; panel story 4, not the other drug stories (1, 5, 13)

items.note: slip: place split (Kathi para for Kathipara); no news word, nothing on screen; panel story 6

items.text: Hey Jarvis, show me the B. I. S. water can one.
items.note: slip: acronym as dotted letters (B. I. S.); no news word, nothing on screen; panel story 10

items.text: Jarvis, the I O C L fire, open that.
items.note: slip: acronym letters (I O C L); no news word; a weekly story that is not on today's panel, asked while the panel shows (the bike-fire story is wrong)

items.text: The balloon price one, read that out.
items.note: no wake word, engaged 4 s; no news word; panel story 14

items.text: Jarvis, tell me the Vandaloor zoo bird flu story.
items.note: slip: place spelt as heard (Vandaloor for Vandalur); weekly store

items.note: no news word; weekly store; three Marina stories that week, the horse pins one (not the water tank or the schoolchildren)

items.text: Jarvis, read me the honking fight in Pattina pakkam.
items.note: slip: place split (Pattina pakkam for Pattinapakkam); no news word; weekly store; the other Pattinapakkam hacking story (gang drags young man) is wrong

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், புழல் ஜெயிலுக்குள்ள போதை மருந்து கடத்தப் பாத்தாங்களே, அந்த நியூஸ படிங்க.
items.note: spoken Tamil: ஜெயிலுக்குள்ள and a spoken verb (கடத்தப் பாத்தாங்க) for the headline's 'bid to smuggle'; panel story 5

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், காசிமேட்டுல படகெல்லாம் வரிசையா நிறுத்தி வச்சிருக்காங்களே, அத காட்டு.
items.note: spoken Tamil (காசிமேட்டுல) describing the photo story in other words; no news word; weekly store

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், கொடுங்கயூர்ல காலி குடத்தோட போராட்டம் பண்ணாங்களே, அத படிங்க.
items.note: slip: place spelt as heard (கொடுங்கயூர் for கொடுங்கையூர்); spoken Tamil for the empty-pot protest; no news word; weekly story not on today's panel, asked while the panel shows

items.text: ஹே ஜார்விஸ், அயனாவரம் பஸ் ஸ்டாண்டு எதிர்ல சாக்கடை ஆறா ஓடுதுன்னு வந்துச்சே, அத திறங்க.
items.note: spoken Tamil (எதிர்ல, ஓடுதுன்னு வந்துச்சே); no news word; panel story 26; the other Ayanavaram story (Mylappa Street potholes) is wrong

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், சோழிங்கநல்லூர்ல ஒன்பதாவது மாடியில இருந்து குதிச்ச பொண்ணு நியூஸ் படிங்க.
items.note: number trap: ஒன்பதாவது is the 9th floor, not panel story 9; spoken Tamil (-ல, பொண்ணு); weekly store, asked while the panel shows

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், கலெக்டர் மாற்றுத்திறனாளிகளுக்கு வண்டி கொடியசைச்சு அனுப்புனாரே, அந்த செய்திய காட்டுங்க.
items.note: spoken Tamil telling the event (கொடியசைச்சு அனுப்புனாரே); panel story 17; the TVK MLA 'collector' story is wrong

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், திருவொற்றியூர்ல ட்ரோன் விழுந்து நொறுங்குச்சாமே, அத சொல்லுங்க.
items.note: spoken Tamil (-ல, நொறுங்குச்சாமே); no news word; weekly store; not the other Thiruvottiyur story (lawyers' protest) nor the Koomam drone-spraying one

items.text: Jarvis, Palli karanai construction ban news padinga.
items.note: slip: place split (Palli karanai); Tanglish labelled en; panel story 19; the South Pallikaranai floodwater-wall story is wrong

items.text: Jarvis, Anna Nagar la corporation land-a occupy panni vechirukkaangale, adha open pannunga.
items.note: slip: the title writes Annanagar as one word, speech gives Anna Nagar; no news word; panel story 15 (Anna Nagar is also a zone, but this asks for the story)

items.text: Jarvis, T V K MLA collector-a harass pannadhu, adha padinga.
items.note: slip: acronym letters (T V K); no news word; panel story 2

items.text: Current thiruttu 24 edathula pudichaangale, adha padinga.
items.note: no wake word, engaged 6 s; number trap: 24 counts places, not panel story 24; everyday Tanglish 'current thiruttu' for electricity theft; no news word; panel story 9

items.text: Jarvis, Kannadasan Nagar bus stand la conductor-a vettunaangale, adha kaattu.
items.note: slip: spelt as heard (Kannadasan for Kannadhasan); no news word; weekly store; the mini bus conductor ear-biting story is wrong

items.text: Jarvis, aaru flyover-ku pudhu look kuduthirukkaanga nu vandhuchu, adha open pannunga.
items.note: number trap: aaru (six) counts flyovers, not panel story 6; no news word; panel story 21

items.note: slip: acronym letters inside a brand name (chat G P T); no news word; weekly store; the other fake-book stories (Agalvilakku raid, DVAC case) are wrong

items.text: Jarvis, what's the latest on the cyclone, is it coming our way or not?
items.note: news question; many cyclone stories qualify (Akvan, Asuran, Murasu)

items.text: Jarvis, anything in the papers about Veera Mani?
items.note: slip: name split (Veera Mani for Veeramani); three Veeramani stories in the week

items.text: Hey Jarvis, what are the papers saying about the free toilets?
items.note: news question; four toilet stories in the week (853 locations, 433 more spots, dressing rooms, Saidapet court)

items.text: Jarvis, any news on the G C C encroachment drive?
items.note: slip: acronym letters (G C C); de-occupation notices (panel 20), unauthorised buildings (27), Annanagar land (15) and road encroachments (weekly) all qualify

items.text: Jarvis, was there news on that High Court cattle order, the licensing thing?
items.note: news question on a single weekly story (Madras HC cattle licensing and tagging)

items.text: Jarvis, what did the papers say about the R.B.I. meeting with the police commissioner?
items.note: slip: acronym as dotted letters (R.B.I.); single weekly story

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், மழை பத்தி என்ன நியூஸ் இருக்கு?
items.note: spoken Tamil பத்தி; rain is told in the cyclone stories (Akvan, heavy rain by November 23)

items.text: Jarvis, அம்பத்தூர்ல என்ன செய்தி?
items.note: spoken Tamil -ல, wake word kept in Latin letters; a news question naming a zone (three Ambattur stories), not the zone's own data

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், சைபர் மோசடி பத்தின செய்தி ஏதாவது வந்திருக்கா?
items.note: spoken Tamil பத்தின; cyber-fraud stories (IT firm swindled of Rs 1.03 crore, RBI on online banking frauds)

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், மரக்கன்னு நடுறது பத்தி ஏதாவது நியூஸ் இருக்கா?
items.note: spoken Tamil (மரக்கன்னு, நடுறது); two sapling stories (12 lakh saplings, Manali 130,000)

items.text: கோயில்ல திருட்டு போனது பத்தி ஏதாவது நியூஸ்?
items.note: no wake word, engaged 8 s; spoken Tamil (கோயில்ல, திருட்டு போனது); two temple burglary stories

items.text: Jarvis, kosu thollai pathi enna news?
items.note: everyday Tanglish 'kosu' (mosquito); the fogging and fever drone-spraying stories; Tanglish labelled en

items.text: Jarvis, Stalin enna solraaru, news la edhavadhu irukka?
items.note: three Stalin stories in the week

items.text: Jarvis, Aavadi la enna news?
items.note: slip: place spelt as heard (Aavadi for Avadi); two Avadi stories

items.text: Jarvis, Tiruvotriyur la enna nadandhuchu, news sollunga.
items.note: slip: another transliteration (Tiruvotriyur for Thiruvottiyur); two Thiruvottiyur stories; a zone name, but a news question

items.text: Jarvis, current cut pathi edhavadhu news irukka?
items.note: everyday Tanglish 'current cut' (power cut); the Thursday shutdown and summer power-woes stories

items.text: Jarvis, open the seventh one.
items.note: English ordinal past five; panel story 7 (bike collides with a lorry)

items.text: Number 11, read that.
items.note: no wake word, engaged 3 s; 'number eleven' written as a digit by Whisper; panel story 11 (summer power woes)

items.text: Hey Jarvis, read out the twelfth one.
items.note: English ordinal past five; panel story 12 (Ambedkar Arts College)

items.text: Jarvis, the last one on the list, open it.
items.note: 'the last one' is panel story 27 (unauthorised buildings)

items.text: Jarvis, open the N D T V one.
items.note: slip: outlet as letters (N D T V); NDTV has one story on the panel (25)

items.text: Jarvis, read the one from Malai Malar.
items.note: slip: outlet misheard (Malai Malar for Maalaimalar); Maalaimalar has one story on the panel (1)

items.text: Jarvis, எட்டாவது செய்திய படிங்க.
items.note: Tamil ordinal past five (எட்டாவது), wake word in Latin letters; panel story 8 (farmer suicide)

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், இருபதாவது நியூஸ திறங்க.
items.note: Tamil ordinal (இருபதாவது); panel story 20 (GCC de-occupation notices)

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், மக்கள் குரல்ல வந்தத படிங்க.
items.note: outlet reference in spoken Tamil (குரல்ல); Makkal Kural has one story on the panel (16, Cyclone Akvan shifts track)

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், லிஸ்ட்ல கடைசியா இருக்கிறத படிங்க.
items.note: கடைசி (last) in spoken Tamil (லிஸ்ட்ல): panel story 27

items.text: Jarvis, pathinettavadhu open pannunga.
items.note: Tanglish ordinal (pathinettavadhu, 18th); panel story 18 (HPV vaccination)

items.text: Irubathi naalavadhu padinga.
items.note: no wake word, engaged 7 s; Tanglish ordinal (24th); panel story 24 (Chief Minister inaugurates 12 works)

items.text: Jarvis, D T Next la vandhadhu open pannu.
items.note: slip: outlet as letters (D T Next); DT Next has one story on the panel (3)

items.text: Jarvis, irubathi rendavadhu news sollunga.
items.note: Tanglish ordinal (22nd); panel story 22 (R.K. Salai constable assault)

items.text: Jarvis, show me the sewage complaints in Royapuram.
items.note: control: 'show' + place + problem word; sewage is also in the news (Ayanavaram), but this wants the zone's complaints

items.text: Jarvis, open the drainage complaints for Ambattur.
items.note: control: 'open' + place + problem word; Ambattur has three news stories, none wanted here

items.text: Jarvis, how's Anna Nagar looking today?
items.note: control: a zone's situation from the console's data; the Annanagar land story is news, not this

items.text: Jarvis, take me back to the overview.
items.note: control: page change while the news panel shows

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், அடையாறுல குப்பை புகார்கள காட்டு.
items.note: control in spoken Tamil (அடையாறுல, புகார்கள): garbage complaints in Adyar; காட்டு is also a news verb

items.text: ஜார்விஸ், புகார் ட்ரெண்ட்ஸ் பக்கத்த திறங்க.
items.note: control: the trends page; திறங்க (open) is also a news verb

items.text: Jarvis, Sholinganallur la pending complaints ellam open pannunga.
items.note: control: 'open' + place + complaints; Sholinganallur has a news story (9th floor), not wanted here

items.text: Jarvis, map la Manali zone kaattu.
items.note: control: the zone on the map; Manali has two news stories (lawyers' protest, saplings) that must not be opened
